56900.meaning1: related to circumstance; concerned with fortune; -fated

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pāpasaṅgatikā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

56901.meaning1: due to circumstance and nature; by fate and conditions
56901.commentary: (MNa) saṅgatibhāvahetū'ti niyatibhāvakāraṇā. (MNt) saṅgatibhāvahetū'ti tattha tattha yadicchāya samuṭṭhitasaṅgatinimittaṃ. sā pana saṅgati niyatilakkhaṇā'ti āha niyatibhāvakāraṇā'ti.

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, sattā saṅgatibhāvahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā pāpasaṅgatikā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

56902.meaning2: having met with, having come together
56902.commentary: (SNPa) sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ saṅgantvā samarocayuṃ, sampiyen'eva aññam'aññaṃ pemen'eva kāyena ca cittena ca missībhūtā saṅghaṭitā saṃsaṭṭhā hutvā saṃvāsaṃ samarocayuṃ, na appiyena na niggahena cā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: na brāhmaṇā aññam'agamuṃ, na'pi bhariyaṃ kiṇiṃsu te, sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ, saṅgantvā samarocayuṃ.
evam'etaṃ purāṇānaṃ, sahāyānaṃ ahu saṅgamo, ubhinnaṃ bhāvitattānaṃ, sarīr'antimadhārinan'ti.

56904.commentary: (VINa) bhikkhunīhi saṅgamitun'ti bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṅgamituṃ saṅgantuṃ samaṅgī bhavituṃ anujānāmī'ti attho.

56905.meaning1: root of attachment; source of snares

examples.text: yass'assu lunāni bandhanāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca saṅgamūlaṃ, sabbasaṅgamūlabandhanā pamutto, ājāniyo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
tam'enaṃ mahā janakāyo saṅgamma samāgamma āyāceyya thomeyya pañjaliko anuparisakkeyya, ayaṃ puriso kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatū'ti.
sabbe saṅgamma mantetvā, māḷaṃ kubbanti satthuno, ekatthambhaṃ alabhantā, vicinanti brahāvane.
dve saṅgayhā parihānaṃ, pamādavihārī ca saṃvaro, samādhi paṭisallānaṃ, dve natumhākena uddako'ti.

56910.commentary: (NPt) hi saccaṃ maraṇakāraṇabhāvatāya ahi-vicchika-visasatth'ādi-anekāya senāya vasena mahāsenena tena maccunā saddhiṃ mittasanthavākārena vā lañjadānena vā saṅgaraṃ n'atthī'ti.

examples.text: ajj'eva kiccam'ātappaṃ, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.

56911.commentary: (JAa) taṃ saṅgaran'ti mayā dhanaṃ te dassāmī'ti brāhmaṇassa saṅgaro kato, taṃ tassa datvā imaṃ mayā vuttaṃ saccaṃ anurakkhanto ahaṃ puna āgamissāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhante ānanda, bahukato buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā, api ca ñātīhi saṅgaro kato, yo bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ na karissati, pañcasatānissa daṇḍo'ti, so kho ahaṃ, bhante ānanda, ñātīnaṃ daṇḍabhayā ev'āhaṃ bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ akāsin'ti.
taṃ taṃ gāmapati brūmi, kadare appasmi jīvite, dve māse saṅgaraṃ katvā, maṃsaṃ jaraggavaṃ kisaṃ.

56912.meaning1: having banded together; having joined together
56912.meaning2: having banded together; having joined together

examples.text: so manusse vadhitvā vadhitvā aṅgulīnaṃ mālaṃ dhāreti. etañ'hi, samaṇa, maggaṃ dasa'pi purisā vīsam'pi purisā tiṃsam'pi purisā cattārīsam'pi purisā paññāsam'pi purisā saṅgaritvā saṅgaritvā paṭipajjanti. te'pi corassa aṅgulimālassa hatth'atthaṃ gacchantī'ti.
mātāpitu upaṭṭhānaṃ, puttadārassa saṅgaho, anākulā ca kamm'antā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena, evam'eva kho, āvuso, ye keci kusalā dhammā sabb'ete catūsu ariyasaccesu saṅgahaṃ gacchanti.
so evaṃ pajānāti, evañ'hi kira imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgaho sannipāto samavāyo hoti.
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅgahavatthūni. katamāni cattāri? dānaṃ, peyyavajjaṃ, atthacariyā, samān'attatā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri saṅgahavatthūnī'ti.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu āvi c'eva raho ca, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo piyakaraṇo garukaraṇo saṅgahāya avivādāya sāmaggiyā ekībhāvāya saṃvattati.

56917.meaning1: agreement (about the postponement of the invitation ceremony)
56917.commentary: (MNa) pavāraṇasaṅgaho nāma ñattidutiyena kammena diyyati kassa pan'esa diyyati, kassa na diyyatī'ti. akārakassa tāva bālaputhujjanassa na diyyati, tathā āraddhavipassakassa c'eva ariyasāvakassa ca. yassa pana samatho vā taruṇo hoti vipassanā vā, tassa diyyati. bhagavā'pi tadā bhikkhūnaṃ citt'ācāraṃ parivīmaṃsanto samathavipassanānaṃ taruṇabhāvaṃ ñatvā, mayi ajja pavārente disāsu vassaṃvuṭṭhā bhikkhū idha osarissanti. tato ime bhikkhū vuḍḍhatarehi bhikkhūhi sen'āsane gahite visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ na sakkhissanti. sace'pi cārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, imesaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ dullabham'eva bhavissati. mayi pana apavārente bhikkhū'pi imaṃ sāvatthiṃ na osarissanti, aham'pi cārikaṃ na pakkamissāmi, evaṃ imesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ apalibuddhaṃ bhavissati. te attano attano vasanaṭṭhāne phāsu viharantā samathavipassanā thāmajātā katvā visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ sakkhissantī'ti so taṃdivasaṃ apavāretvā kattikapuṇṇamāyaṃ pavāressāmī'ti bhikkhūnaṃ pavāraṇasaṅgahaṃ anujāni. pavāraṇasaṅgahasmiñ'hi laddhe yassa nissayapaṭipannassa ācariy'upajjhāyā pakkamanti, so'pi sace patirūpo nissayadāyako āgamissati, tassa santike nissayaṃ gaṇhissāmī'ti yāva gimhānaṃ pacchimamāsā vasituṃ labhati. sace'pi saṭṭhivassā bhikkhū āgacchanti, tassa sen'āsanaṃ gahetuṃ na labhanti. ayañ'ca pana pavāraṇasaṅgaho ekassa dinno'pi sabbesaṃ dinno'y'eva hoti.

examples.text: evaṃ mayaṃ imamhā phāsuvihārā paribāhirā bhavissāmā'ti, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, tehi bhikkhūhi pavāraṇāsaṅgahaṃ kātuṃ.
mahāpadāna nidānaṃ, nibbānañ'ca sudassanaṃ, janavasabha govindaṃ, samayaṃ sakkapañhakaṃ, satipaṭṭhānapāyāsi, mahāvaggassa saṅgaho.

56921.meaning1: power of supporting; strength of inclusiveness

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, anavajjabalaṃ, saṅgahabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri balānī'ti.
katamaṃ saṅgahabalaṃ? kāmacchandaṃ pajahanto nekkhammavasena cittaṃ saṅgaṇhātī'ti, saṅgahabalaṃ.
cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, saṅgahavatthūni. katamāni cattāri? dānaṃ, peyyavajjaṃ, atthacariyā, samān'attatā, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri saṅgahavatthūnī'ti.

56924.meaningLit: discourse on the basis for sustaining relationships

56925.meaning1: is included (in); is encompassed (by); is encapsulated (in); is grouped together (with)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena, evam'eva kho, āvuso, ye keci kusalā dhammā sabb'ete catūsu ariyasaccesu saṅgahaṃ gacchanti.
ye tathābhūtassa saṅkhārā te saṅkhār'upādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchanti, yaṃ tathābhūtassa viññāṇaṃ taṃ viññāṇ'upādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati.
pattakallan'ti vuccati kiṃ? saṅghassa uposathakammaṃ imehi catūhi lakkhaṇehi saṅgahitaṃ pattakallan'ti vuccati. pattakallavantan'ti akkhātaṃ.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: evan'taṃ uposathakammaṃ imehi catūhi lakkhaṇehi saṅgahitaṃ pattakallaṃ nāma hoti, kātuṃ yuttarūpaṃ.
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
yo ca sammāvāyāmo yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāsamādhi ime dhammā samādhikkhandhe saṅgahitā. yā ca sammādiṭṭhi yo ca sammāsaṅkappo, ime dhammā paññākkhandhe saṅgahitā'ti.

56931.meaning1: who manages the servants; who arranges the workers

examples.text: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.

56932.meaning1: who manages the servants; who arranges the workers
56932.commentary: (ANt) saṅgahitaparijjanā'ti sammānan'ādīhi c'eva chaṇ'ādīsu pesetabba-piyabhaṇḍ'ādi-paṇṇ'ākāra-pesan'ādīhi ca saṅgahitaparijanā. idha parijano nāma sāmikassa c'eva attano ca ñātijano.

examples.text: susaṃvihitakamm'antā, saṅgahitaparijjanā, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
ghos'āghosasaññā ca parasamaññā payoge'ti saṅgahītā.

56936.meaning1: who has overcome attachment; who has transcended clinging
56936.commentary: (SNa) pañca saṅg'ātigo'ti rāgasaṅgo dosasaṅgo mohasaṅgo mānasaṅgo diṭṭhisaṅgo'ti ime pañca saṅge atikkanto.

examples.text: pañca chinde pañca jahe, pañca c'uttari bhāvaye, pañca saṅg'ātigo bhikkhu, oghatiṇṇo'ti vuccati.
pasaṃsiyā te'pi bhavanti bhikkhū, ye taṃ namassanti tathāvimuttaṃ, aññāya dhammaṃ vicikicchaṃ pahāya, saṅg'ātigā te'pi bhavanti bhikkhū'ti.
tass'eva tena pāpiyo, yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati, kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto, saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ.
yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, dev'āsurasaṅgāmo samupabyūḷho ahosi. atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo asure āmantesi

56939.meaning1: gone to war; engaged in battle

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthim'pi hanati, hatth'āruham'pi hanati, assam'pi hanati, ass'āruham'pi hanati, ratham'pi hanati, rathikam'pi hanati, pattikam'pi hanati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo hantā hoti.

56940.meaning1: winner in war; victor in battle

examples.text: yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaji-uttamo, attā have jitaṃ seyyo, yā c'āyaṃ itarā pajā.

56942.meaning1: forefront of the battle; front line of the war
56942.commentary: (THa) nāgo saṅgāmasīse'vā'ti yathā nāma ājāneyyo hatthināgo yuddhamaṇḍale asisattitomar'ādippahāre adhivāsetvā parasenaṃ viddhaṃseti

examples.text: phuṭṭho ḍaṃsehi makasehi, araññasmiṃ brahāvane, nāgo saṅgāmasīs'eva, sato tatr'ādhivāsaye.

56943.meaning1: victory in war; triumph in battle
56943.meaning2: victory in war; triumph in battle
56943.commentary: (SNa) anuttarattā kilesasaṅgāmassa ca vijitattā anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pi vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.

56944.meaning1: accustomed to the battle-field; used to war

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti

ahosiṃ ahaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro.

56947.meaning2: fights, comes into conflict, fights a battle

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati, tasmiṃ samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati, eso ariyasāvako mārena saddhiṃ saṅgāmetī'ti.

56948.meaning1: to wage war (with); to fight a battle (against)

56949.meaning2: having fought, having come into conflict

examples.text: atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ ajātasattuṃ vedehiputtaṃ paccuyyāsi yena kāsi. atha kho rājā ca māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājā ca pasenadi kosalo saṅgāmesuṃ.

atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, kattha nu kho mayaṃ dhammañ'ca vinayañ'ca saṅgāyeyyāmā'ti? atha kho therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, rājagahaṃ kho mahāgocaraṃ pahūtasen'āsanaṃ, yaṃnūna mayaṃ rājagahe vassaṃ vasantā dhammañ'ca vinayañ'ca saṅgāyeyyāma.

56953.meaning1: group chanting; reciting as a community

56956.meaning1: should be recited together; should be chanted in concert
56956.meaning2: should be chanted together; should be recited in concert
56956.commentary: (DNa) saṅgāyitabban'ti vācetabbaṃ sajjhāyitabbaṃ. (DNa) saṅgāyitabban'ti samaggehi gāyitabbaṃ, ekavacanehi aviruddhavacanehi bhaṇitabbaṃ.

examples.text: yattha sabbeh'eva saṅgamma samāgamma atthena atthaṃ byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṅgāyitabbaṃ na vivaditabbaṃ, yatha'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ addhaniyaṃ assa ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
buddhā saṅgāhakā loke, tehi etaṃ sudesitaṃ, eso hetu mahantassa, pathabyo me na vipajjati.

56970.synonym: caya, saṅgaṇa, saṅgāha, saṅghāṭa, saṅghāta, sañcaya, saṃhāra

examples.text: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno mahājanasaṅgāhakaṃ samekkhamāno samaṃ jānāti sāmaṃ jānāti, purisaṃ jānāti purisavisesaṃ jānāti, ayam'idam'arahati ayam'idam'arahatī'ti tattha tattha purisavisesakaro ahosi.

56971.meaning2: who collects, compiles, or holds together
56971.commentary: (MNa) sabbagopānasiyo saṅgaṇhātī'ti saṅgāhikaṃ. (ANa) sesabalāni gopānasiyo kūṭaṃ viya saṅgaṇhātī'ti saṅgāhikaṃ.

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, channaṃ sāraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṅgāhakaṃ etaṃ saṅghāṭanikaṃ, yadidaṃ y'āyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

atha kho, ānanda, sakko devānam'indo mātaliṃ saṅgāhakaṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā nimiṃ rājānaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadehi, ayaṃ te, mahārāja, sahassayutto ājaññaratho sakkena devānam'indena pesito, abhiruheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṃ yānaṃ avikampamāno'ti.

56973.meaning1: which holds together; which supports (the others)

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, channaṃ sāraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ saṅgāhikaṃ etaṃ saṅghāṭanikaṃ, yadidaṃ y'āyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bāhuraggi ca saṅgiyo. te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
dibbāni'pi saṅgītāni antalikkhe vattanti tathāgatassa pūjāya. na kho, ānanda, ettāvatā tathāgato sakkato vā hoti garukato vā mānito vā pūjito vā apacito vā.

56980.commentary: (DNa) saṅgītipariyāyan'ti sāmaggiyā kāraṇaṃ. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, sādhu, kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, mama sabbaññutaññāṇena saṃsanditvā bhikkhūnaṃ sāmaggirasaṃ abhāsī'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi, sādhu sādhu, sāriputta, sādhu kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhūnaṃ saṅgītipariyāyaṃ abhāsī'ti. idam'avoc'āyasmā sāriputto, samanuñño satthā ahosi.

56981.meaning2: rehearsal, Buddhist council, convocation of the Buddhist clergy in order to settle questions of doctrine
56981.commentary: (DNa) pañcasatikā, sattasatikā, sahassikā'ti imā pana tisso saṅgītiyo.

examples.text: imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā pañca bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ. tasmā ayaṃ vinayasaṅgīti pañcasatikā'ti vuccatī'ti.

56984.meaning1: discourse for communal recitation; (comm) cause for concord
56984.commentary: (DNa) saṅgītipariyāyan'ti sāmaggiyā kāraṇaṃ. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, sādhu, kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, mama sabbaññutaññāṇena saṃsanditvā bhikkhūnaṃ sāmaggirasaṃ abhāsī'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi, sādhu sādhu, sāriputta, sādhu kho tvaṃ, sāriputta, bhikkhūnaṃ saṅgītipariyāyaṃ abhāsī'ti. idam'avoc'āyasmā sāriputto, samanuñño satthā ahosi.

56989.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhisīlasaṅghātena saṃhato'ti saṅgho, so atthato aṭṭha ariyapuggalasamūho.

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse saṅgho viharati sathero sapāmokkho. tassa me saṅghassa sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, ayaṃ dhammo, ayaṃ vinayo, idaṃ satthusāsanan'ti.
yo ca buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca, saṅghañ'ca saraṇaṃ gato, cattāri ariyasaccāni, sammappaññāya passati.

56990.meaning1: group; crowd; mass; multitude; collection; entourage
56990.synonym: kāya, gaṇa, saṅkhepa, saṅghāṭa, saṅghāta, saṇḍa, samudāya

examples.text: mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

56991.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.

56992.meaning2: act performed by a chapter of Buddhist monks

examples.text: saṃvaseyya vā'ti ukkhittakena saddhiṃ uposathaṃ vā pavāraṇaṃ vā saṅghakammaṃ vā karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
ajja't'agge dān'āhaṃ, āvuso ānanda, aññatr'eva bhagavatā aññatra bhikkhusaṅghena uposathaṃ karissāmi saṅghakammañ'cā'ti

56993.meaning1: duty of the community; business matter of the Saṅgha; community-related work
56993.commentary: (VINa) saṅghakaraṇīyenā'ti ettha yaṃkiñci uposath'āgār'ādīsu sen'āsanesu cetiyachattavedik'ādīsu vā kattabbaṃ, antamaso bhikkhuno puggalikasen'āsanam'pi, sabbaṃ saṅghakaraṇīyam'eva.

examples.text: yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā saṅghakaraṇīyāni karissanti

56994.meaning1: in the midst of the community
56994.meaning2: gone into or given to the community

examples.text: saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.

56995.meaning1: immersed in the community; focused on the community

examples.text: suppabuddhaṃ pabujjhanti, sadā gotamasāvakā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, niccaṃ saṅghagatā sati.

56996.meaning1: blaming the community; finding fault with the monastic order
56996.commentary: (VINa) na mayaṃ, bhante ānanda, buddhagarahino'ti bhante ānanda, mayaṃ na buddhaṃ garahāma, na buddhassa dosaṃ dema. na dhammagarahino, na saṅghagarahino.

56997.meaning1: respectful towards the community; giving weight to the monastic order

examples.text: ye c'aññe bhikkhū saṅghagāravā tesañ'ca vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇati bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ kālena. attanā ca saṅghagāravo hoti, saṅghagāravatāya ca vaṇṇavādī.

56998.meaning1: fact of having respect for the community; fact of giving weight to the monastic order

examples.text: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭā samodhānā usmā jāyati, tejo abhinibbattati, tesaṃ'y'eva dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvā vikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati
